newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Coalminers in the Jiu valley pressed on with their strike over pay demands. The miners dissatisfied by the 15 percent pay increase proposed by the government and maintained demands for 45 percent.
* Officials from the Transport Ministry said they believed Jiu Valley miners planned to block roads, halt trains and move on to Bucharest.
* The Transport Ministry intends to limit train traffic to the Jiu Valley to prevent incidents between miners and passengers.
* U.S. President Bill Clinton sent a letter to Romanian President Emil Constantinescu. Clinton said the United States would keep the door open for the future enlargement of NATO.
* Constantinescu received another letter from French President Jaques Chirac. The letter said France would maintain its support for Romania's NATO membership bid.
* Romania's Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea left for the United States to present Romania's current situation.
